mapper.select: SELECT * FROM english_word ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO english_word (word, phonetic, meaning, category, example, emoji, sort_order) VALUES (#{word}, #{phonetic}, #{meaning}, #{category}, #{example}, #{emoji}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE english_word SET word = #{word}, phonetic = #{phonetic}, meaning = #{meaning}, category = #{category}, example = #{example}, emoji = #{emoji}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
